color.note: Neutral base with one calm teal accent taken from the app icon. No red for data, ever; destructive is reserved for delete actions.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind grouped lists and cards (SwiftUI: a custom groupedBackground).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list cells, sheets, widgets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Range band track, segmented control well, neutral badge fill, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline separators and card outlines. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Text field and toggle borders, the empty ring of a not-logged calendar day, chart axis ticks. At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers, on bg, surface and surface-sunken. Also the value marker on a range band, inside or outside the band alike.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, units, metadata, section footers, on bg, surface and surface-sunken (at least 4.5:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary buttons, links, selected tab, selected calendar day, range band edges, the weight trend line. As text on bg, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an accent fill (primary button). Never literal white in dark.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind accent text: the Your numbers badge, the selected day, info banners.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Target range band on the track and the target band behind chart bars. Edges are drawn in accent so the band reads without relying on this fill.

tokens.name: protein
tokens.usage: Protein marks in charts and the macro dot. Always next to the word Protein or P.

tokens.name: fat
tokens.usage: Fat marks in charts and the macro dot (amber, not orange-red). Always next to the word Fat or F.

tokens.name: carbs
tokens.usage: Carbohydrate marks in charts and the macro dot. Always next to the word Carbs or C.

tokens.name: destructive
tokens.usage: Only for the labels of irreversible actions (Delete meal, Delete account, Delete all weight data, Revoke), on surface. Never for data, targets or weight.

tokens.name: chart-faded
tokens.usage: Raw weigh-in dots behind the smoothed weight line, bars for partial days. Decorative layer; values are carried by the labeled trend.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links, Copy and Retry buttons. Alias of accent.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", system-ui, sans-serif
families.rounded: ui-rounded, "SF Pro Rounded", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Dynamic Type
groups.note: Apple text styles at the default (Large) content size. In SwiftUI use .font(.body) etc., never fixed sizes, so every style scales up to AX5.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: .headline: meal names, row titles, button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Log food in the chat you already use.
styles.usage: .body: default reading text and list values.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Your data stays on your server.

styles.name: footnote
styles.sample: Last meal saved 2 h ago via Claude
styles.usage: .footnote: status line, section footers, the days-counted line.

styles.name: caption-2
styles.usage: .caption2: axis labels, weekday headers. Never for anything a person must read to act.

groups.name: Numbers
groups.note: SF Pro Rounded (.fontDesign(.rounded)) with .monospacedDigit() for every figure, echoing the icon's rounded strokes. Same Dynamic Type scaling.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The one hero number on a screen: today's kcal on the summary card, D3 maintenance estimate. Based on .largeTitle, scaled with @ScaledMetric.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: .headline.rounded: kcal and grams in rows and macro lines.

spacing.note: 4 pt base. Screen margins follow the system (16 pt on iPhone in compact width).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, badge internal gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between badge and confidence, between lines inside a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row vertical padding, gap between macro lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and list sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between onboarding blocks, above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Onboarding top and bottom breathing room, empty-state padding.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every control (HIG).

radius.note: Soft and continuous (SwiftUI .continuous corner style), like the icon's bubble. No sharp corners, no fully round cards.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chart bar tops, range band track ends.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Provenance badges, chips, the segmented thumb.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text fields, buttons, inset grouped list sections, banners.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Summary card, chart cards, sheets' top corners.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Day dots, confidence pips, toggles.

shadow.note: Flat. Cards separate from bg by fill, not by shadow. One shadow only for floating chrome.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Floating elements only: the Copied toast, the segmented thumb.
